title: Understanding Non-linear Relationships
text: The scatterplot shows a non-linear relationship between the amount of antibiotic and the number of colonies. Consider transformations that can help linearize such relationships. Common transformations include logarithmic, square root, and reciprocal transformations.

title: Exploring Transformations
text: Which of the following transformations could help linearize a decreasing exponential relationship?

title: Logarithmic Transformation
text: A logarithmic transformation can be useful when the rate of change decreases as the independent variable increases. This is often seen in exponential decay relationships.
